subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Should Feishu peer routing be fixed by reinterpreting `feishu:<id>` with an `account:` escape in this PR, or should maintainers choose a different compatibility-safe bind grammar or sibling candidate?
rationale: The PR changes a documented CLI input that writes persisted route bindings, and the code evidence shows existing account/channel bind semantics and a separate heartbeat behavior are affected.

options.title: Restore bind compatibility first
options.body: Keep `--bind <channel>` on the existing resolver path and preserve or explicitly migrate Feishu account binds before changing Feishu peer generation.

options.title: Adopt another candidate
options.body: Pause this PR and choose a sibling candidate if it better preserves account semantics and can provide proof for the canonical Feishu issue.

options.title: Accept the new grammar intentionally
options.body: Land this direction only with maintainer-owned compatibility notes, docs, tests, and proof that existing account-scoped setups remain expressible.

recommendation.title: Restore bind compatibility first
recommendation.body: Keep `--bind <channel>` on the existing resolver path and preserve or explicitly migrate Feishu account binds before changing Feishu peer generation.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle authored and merged the account-scoped bind command surface whose compatibility contract is being changed.
